name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a junior silver-gold explorer with its flagship Diablillos project located in Salta Province, Argentina. The company is in the exploration stage with an updated NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate and an active drill program targeting high-grade silver-gold mineralization at Oculto and adjacent zones. In 2026, AbraSilver completed the acquisition of the Condoryacu and Maria Amalia properties, expanding its land package directly adjacent to Diablillos.
